**Task 1a: Data Acquisition - State Electricity Profiles**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(httr2)
library(rvest)

get_eia_sep <- function(state, abbr){
    library(tidyverse)
    library(stringr)
    library(httr2)
    library(rvest)
    library(fs)
  
    state_formatted <- str_to_lower(state) |> str_replace_all("\\s", "")
    
    dir_name <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
    file_name <- fs::path(dir_name, state_formatted)
    
    fs::dir_create(dir_name, recurse=TRUE)
    
    if(!fs::file_exists(file_name)){
        BASE_URL <- "https://www.eia.gov"
        RESPONSE <- request(BASE_URL) |> 
          req_url_path("electricity", 
                       "state", 
                       state_formatted) |>
          req_headers(
            `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0"
            ) |>   
          req_retry(
                max_tries = 4, 
          ) |>
          req_perform(file_name)
    
        resp_check_status(RESPONSE)
    }
    
    TABLE <- read_html(file_name) |> 
        html_element("table") |> 
        html_table() |>
        mutate(Item = str_to_lower(Item))
    
    if("U.S. rank" %in% colnames(TABLE)){
        TABLE <- TABLE |> rename(Rank = `U.S. rank`)
    }
    
    CO2_MWh <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "carbon dioxide (lbs/mwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |> 
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    PRIMARY <- TABLE |> 
        filter(Item == "primary energy source") |> 
        pull(Rank)
    
    RATE <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "average retail price (cents/kwh)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        as.numeric()
    
    GENERATION_MWh <- TABLE |>
        filter(Item == "net generation (megawatthours)") |>
        pull(Value) |>
        str_replace_all(",", "") |>
        as.numeric()
    
    data.frame(CO2_MWh               = CO2_MWh, 
               primary_source        = PRIMARY,
               electricity_price_MWh = RATE * 10, # / 100 cents to dollars &
               # * 1000 kWh to MWH 
               generation_MWh        = GENERATION_MWh, 
               state                 = state, 
               abbreviation          = abbr
    )
}

EIA_SEP_REPORT <- map2(state.name, state.abb, get_eia_sep) |> list_rbind()
head(EIA_SEP_REPORT, 5)
```

**Task 1b: Data Acquisition - NTD Energy Usage**
```{r}
load_ntd_energy <- function(){
  library(readxl)
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_ENERGY_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_energy.xlsx")

  # error in pulling data from the website so i manually downloaded instea
  # if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)){
  #   library(httr2)
  # 
  #   request("https://www.transit.dot.gov/") |>
  #     req_url_path("sites",
  #                  "fta.dot.gov",
  #                  "files",
  #                  "2026-09",
  #                  "2025 Energy Consumption_260806.xlsx") |> 
  #     req_headers(
  #       `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
  #     req_perform(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)
  # }
  # 
  # if(file.info(NTD_ENERGY_FILE)$size < 1e4){
  #       cat("I was unable to download the NTD Energy File. Please try again.\n")
  #       stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_energy.xlsx')` and try again.")
  #   }

  to_numeric_fill_0 <- function(x){
    x <- if_else(x == "-", NA, x)
    replace_na(as.numeric(x), 0)
  }

  read_excel(NTD_ENERGY_FILE) |> 
    select(-c(`Reporter Type`, 
              `Reporting Module`, 
              `Gallons of Other Fuel`, 
              `Other Fuel Description`)) |>
    mutate(across(-c(`Agency Name`, 
                     `Mode`,
                     `TOS`), 
                  to_numeric_fill_0)) |>
    group_by(`NTD ID`, `Mode`, `Agency Name`) |>
    summarize(across(where(is.numeric), sum), 
              .groups = "keep") |>
    mutate(ENERGY = sum(c_across(c(where(is.numeric))))) |>
    filter(ENERGY > 0) |>
    select(-ENERGY) |>
    ungroup()
}

NTD_ENERGY <- load_ntd_energy()
head(NTD_ENERGY, 5)
```

**Task 1c: Data Acquisition - Service Provided**
```{r}
load_ntd_service <- function(){
  library(httr2)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(fs)
  
  # Create 'data/mp02' directory if not already present
  DATA_DIR <- fs::path("data", "mp02")
  fs::dir_create(DATA_DIR, recurse=TRUE)

  NTD_SERVICE_FILE <- fs::path(DATA_DIR, "2025_ntd_service.csv")

  if(!fs::file_exists(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)){
    library(httr2)
  
    request("https://data.transportation.gov/resource/4fir-qbim.csv") |>
      req_url_query(`$query`=paste(
        "SELECT  `_5_digit_ntd_id` AS `NTD_ID`", 
        "`max_agency` AS `AGENCY`",
        "`max_reporter_type` AS `reporter_type`",
        "`max_organization_type` AS `organization_type`",
        "`max_city` AS `city`",
        "`max_state` AS `state`",
        "`mode`",
        "`type_of_service`",
        "`max_primary_uza_code` as `uza_code`",
        "`max_primary_uza_name` as `uza_name`",
        "`max_primary_uza_area_sq_miles` as `uza_sq_miles`",
        "`max_primary_uza_population` as `uza_population`",
        "`max_service_area_sq_miles` as `service_area_sq_miles`",
        "`max_service_area_population` as `service_area_population`",
        "`questionable_record` as `flagged_likely_inaccurate`",
        "`sum_unlinked_passenger_trips_upt` as `total_upt`",
        "`sum_passenger_miles` WHERE caseless_one_of(`report_year`, '2025') limit 50000", 
        sep=",")) |>
      req_headers(
        `User-Agent` = "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:149.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/149.0") |> 
      req_perform(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)
  }
  
  if(file.info(NTD_SERVICE_FILE)$size < 1e4){
        cat("I was unable to download the NTD Service File. Please try again.\n")
        stop("Download failed. Please delete the corrupted file by running `unlink('data/mp02/2025_ntd_service.xlsx')` and try again.")
    }

  read_csv(NTD_SERVICE_FILE) |>
    mutate(flagged_likely_inaccurate = !is.na(flagged_likely_inaccurate))
}

NTD_SERVICE <- load_ntd_service()
head(NTD_SERVICE, 5)
```

**Task 5: Calculate Emissions**
```{r}

library(tidyverse)


# Prepare state information
agency_state <- NTD_SERVICE |>
  mutate(
    NTD_ID = as.character(NTD_ID),
    mode = as.character(mode),
    state = str_trim(state),
    abbreviation = if_else(
      nchar(state) == 2,
      toupper(state),
      state.abb[match(state, state.name)]
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(NTD_ID, mode, state, abbreviation)

# Prepare energy data
energy_data <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  mutate(
    `NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`),
    Mode = as.character(Mode)
  )

# Join energy and service information
energy_service <- energy_data |>
  left_join(
    agency_state,
    by = c("NTD ID" = "NTD_ID", "Mode" = "mode")
  )

# Join state electricity emissions factors
FINAL_EMISSIONS <- energy_service |>
  left_join(
    EIA_SEP_REPORT |>
      select(abbreviation, CO2_MWh),
    by = "abbreviation"
  )

# Calculate total CO2 emissions
FINAL_EMISSIONS <- FINAL_EMISSIONS |>
  mutate(
    total_CO2_lbs =

      # Biodiesel: 20.83 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Bio-Diesel` * 20.83 +

      # Bunker fuel: residual fuel oil proxy
      `Gallons of Bunker Fuel` * 24.78 +

      # CNG: assumes gallons are gasoline-gallon equivalents
      `Gallons of Compressed Natural Gas` * 22.40 +

      # Diesel: 22.45 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Diesel Fuel` * 22.45 +

      # Ethanol: 12.68 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Ethanol` * 12.68 +

      # Gasoline: 18.73 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Gasoline` * 18.73 +

      # Kerosene: 21.78 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Kerosene` * 21.78 +

      # LNG: 9.92 lbs/gallon
      `Gallons of Liquified Nat Gas` * 9.92 +

      # LPG: propane-based factor
      `Gallons of Liquified Petroleum Gas` * 12.68 +

      # Hydrogen: zero direct CO2 from combustion
      `Gallons of Hydrogen` * 0 +

      # Electricity: convert kWh to MWh
      (
        `Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery` +
        `Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion`
      ) / 1000 * CO2_MWh
  )

# Display final table
FINAL_EMISSIONS
```

**Task 6: Normalize Emissions to Transit Usage**
Using the total emissions calculated above, compute the emissions:

1. Per UPT; and
2. Per passenger mile

Which agencies are most efficient on these bases? You may want to filter out extremely small agencies and to create “small”, “medium”, and “large” agencies so that you can give multiple awards.

Note that transit usage is reported at the Agency level, so you may need to sum emissions across multiple modes.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# STEP 1: Aggregate emissions across all modes by agency
agency_emissions <- FINAL_EMISSIONS |>
  mutate(`NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`)) |>
  group_by(`NTD ID`, `Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(
    total_CO2_lbs = sum(total_CO2_lbs, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 2: Aggregate UPT and passenger miles by agency
agency_ridership <- NTD_SERVICE |>
  filter(!flagged_likely_inaccurate) |>
  mutate(NTD_ID = as.character(NTD_ID)) |>
  group_by(NTD_ID, AGENCY) |>
  summarize(
    total_upt = sum(total_upt, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_pmt = sum(sum_passenger_miles, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 3: Join emissions and ridership
agency_efficiency <- agency_emissions |>
  inner_join(
    agency_ridership,
    by = c("NTD ID" = "NTD_ID")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    emissions_per_UPT = total_CO2_lbs / total_upt,
    emissions_per_passenger_mile = total_CO2_lbs / total_pmt
  ) |>
  filter(
    total_upt > 0,
    total_pmt > 0,
    is.finite(emissions_per_UPT),
    is.finite(emissions_per_passenger_mile)
  )

# STEP 4: Calculate emissions efficiency
agency_efficiency <- agency_efficiency |>
  filter(total_upt >= 10000) |>
  mutate(
    agency_size = factor(
      ntile(total_upt, 3),
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large")
    )
  )

# View results
agency_efficiency

# STEP 5: Classify agency sizes
nrow(agency_efficiency)
head(agency_efficiency)

# STEP 6: Rank agencies by emissions per UPT
upt_winners <- agency_efficiency |>
  group_by(agency_size) |>
  slice_min(
    emissions_per_UPT,
    n = 5,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(agency_size, emissions_per_UPT) |>
  ungroup()

# STEP 7: Rank agencies by emissions per passenger mile
mile_winners <- agency_efficiency |>
  group_by(agency_size) |>
  slice_min(
    emissions_per_passenger_mile,
    n = 5,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  arrange(agency_size, emissions_per_passenger_mile) |>
  ungroup()

# Display winners
upt_winners |>
  select(
    AGENCY,
    agency_size,
    total_upt,
    total_CO2_lbs,
    emissions_per_UPT
  )

mile_winners |>
  select(
    AGENCY,
    agency_size,
    total_pmt,
    total_CO2_lbs,
    emissions_per_passenger_mile
  )

#Emissions per UPT
agency_efficiency <- agency_emissions |>
  mutate(`NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`)) |>
  inner_join(agency_ridership, by = c("NTD ID" = "NTD_ID")) |>
  filter(total_upt >= 10000, total_upt > 0, total_pmt > 0) |>
  mutate(
    emissions_per_UPT = total_CO2_lbs / total_upt,
    emissions_per_passenger_mile = total_CO2_lbs / total_pmt,
    agency_size = factor(
      ntile(total_upt, 3),
      labels = c("Small", "Medium", "Large")
    )
  )

#Emissions per passenger mile
upt_winners <- agency_efficiency |>
  group_by(agency_size) |>
  slice_min(emissions_per_UPT, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

mile_winners <- agency_efficiency |>
  group_by(agency_size) |>
  slice_min(emissions_per_passenger_mile, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()
```

Emissions per UPT:

The most efficient small transit agency is **`r upt_winners$AGENCY[upt_winners$agency_size == "Small"]`**, with **`r round(upt_winners$emissions_per_UPT[upt_winners$agency_size == "Small"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per UPT.

The most efficient medium transit agency is **`r upt_winners$AGENCY[upt_winners$agency_size == "Medium"]`**, with **`r round(upt_winners$emissions_per_UPT[upt_winners$agency_size == "Medium"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per UPT.

The most efficient large transit agency is **`r upt_winners$AGENCY[upt_winners$agency_size == "Large"]`**, with **`r round(upt_winners$emissions_per_UPT[upt_winners$agency_size == "Large"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per UPT.

Emissions per passenger mile:

The most efficient small transit agency is **`r mile_winners$AGENCY[mile_winners$agency_size == "Small"]`**, with **`r round(mile_winners$emissions_per_passenger_mile[mile_winners$agency_size == "Small"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per passenger mile.

The most efficient medium transit agency is **`r mile_winners$AGENCY[mile_winners$agency_size == "Medium"]`**, with **`r round(mile_winners$emissions_per_passenger_mile[mile_winners$agency_size == "Medium"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per passenger mile.

The most efficient large transit agency is **`r mile_winners$AGENCY[mile_winners$agency_size == "Large"]`**, with **`r round(mile_winners$emissions_per_passenger_mile[mile_winners$agency_size == "Large"], 4)`** pounds of CO2 per passenger mile.


**Task 7: Determine Award Winners**

```{r}
# Constants
CAFE_MPG <- 30.4
GASOLINE_CO2 <- 19.59

# Keep agencies with at least 10,000 UPT
award_data <- agency_efficiency |>
  filter(
    total_upt >= 10000,
    total_pmt > 0,
    total_CO2_lbs >= 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Estimated emissions if all passenger miles were driven
    driving_gallons = total_pmt / CAFE_MPG,

    driving_CO2_lbs = driving_gallons * GASOLINE_CO2,

    # Emissions avoided by using transit
    emissions_avoided = driving_CO2_lbs - total_CO2_lbs
  )

# AWARD 1: Greenest Transit Agency
greenest <- award_data |>
  slice_min(
    emissions_per_passenger_mile,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )

# AWARD 2: Most Emissions Avoided
most_avoided <- award_data |>
  slice_max(
    emissions_avoided,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )
```

**Award 1: Greenest Transit Agency**

The Greenest Transit Agency award goes to **`r greenest$AGENCY[1]`**, with emissions of `r round(greenest$emissions_per_passenger_mile[1], 4)` pounds of CO₂ per passenger mile.

**Award 2: Most Emissions Avoided**

The Most Emissions Avoided award goes to **`r most_avoided$AGENCY[1]`**, which avoided an estimated `r format(round(most_avoided$emissions_avoided[1]), big.mark = ",")` pounds of CO₂ compared with individual driving.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Use the same eligible agencies for all award comparisons
award_data <- agency_efficiency |>
  filter(
    total_upt >= 10000,
    total_pmt > 0,
    total_CO2_lbs >= 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    driving_CO2_lbs = (total_pmt / 30.4) * 18.73,
    emissions_avoided = driving_CO2_lbs - total_CO2_lbs
  )

# Award winners
greenest <- award_data |>
  slice_min(emissions_per_passenger_mile, n = 1)

most_avoided <- award_data |>
  slice_max(emissions_avoided, n = 1)

worst_agency <- award_data |>
  slice_max(emissions_per_passenger_mile, n = 1)

# Median reference values
median_efficiency <- median(
  award_data$emissions_per_passenger_mile,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

median_avoided <- median(
  award_data$emissions_avoided,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

median_UPT <- median(
  award_data$emissions_per_UPT,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Electric Pioneer
electricity_by_agency <- NTD_ENERGY |>
  mutate(
    `NTD ID` = as.character(`NTD ID`),
    electric_kwh =
      coalesce(`Kilowatt hours of Electric Battery`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Kilowatt hours of Electric Propulsion`, 0)
  ) |>
  group_by(`NTD ID`, `Agency Name`) |>
  summarize(
    total_modes = n_distinct(Mode),
    electric_modes = n_distinct(Mode[electric_kwh > 0]),
    electric_mode_share = electric_modes / total_modes,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

electric_winner <- electricity_by_agency |>
  slice_max(electric_mode_share, n = 1)

median_electric <- median(
  electricity_by_agency$electric_mode_share,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Reference driving emissions per passenger mile
car_emissions_per_mile <- 18.73 / 30.4
```

**Award 1: Greenest Transit Agency**
```{r}

efficiency_comparison <- tibble(
  Category = c(
    "Greenest transit agency",
    "Median transit agency",
    "Single-occupant gasoline car"
  ),
  Emissions = c(
    greenest$emissions_per_passenger_mile[1],
    median_efficiency,
    car_emissions_per_mile
  )
)

ggplot(
  efficiency_comparison,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Category, Emissions),
    y = Emissions,
    fill = Category
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(Emissions, 3)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Greenest transit agency" = "#16865B",
    "Median transit agency" = "#7D8790",
    "Single-occupant gasoline car" = "#C77B38"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The Greenest Transit Agency",
    subtitle = "CO2 emissions per passenger mile",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pounds of CO2 per passenger mile",
    caption = paste(
      "Sources: 2025 FTA National Transit Database;",
      "EIA gasoline emissions coefficient;",
      "CAFE comparison assumption of 30.4 MPG."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}

avoided_top10 <- award_data |>
```
